programme.title: Outlier: Manager Idol
programme.desc: This premium sports documentary tells the stranger-than-fiction story of the only manager in British football to ever be appointed by a phone vote. The story of a chairman inspired by Pop Idol in a bid to win over fans, during a summer where the money men and fans went to battle for control of Luton Town football club. In 2003, Luton Town were in crisis. New chairman John Gurney was the face of a mystery consortium that turned fans against their own club. Luton Town fans rose up against their own chairman - forging a maverick plot to buy the club's debt and put their own club into administration - to oust the chairman and change the club's future. This is the nightmare origin story of a fan movement that would turn into a dream. The fans that fought for the future of their club, led it on a historic journey from non league all the way to the promised land and riches of the Premier League.

programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.desc: Following a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watching for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks waiting for the rains to come.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack
programme.desc: An emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corners a tough warthog.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild
programme.desc: Sea lion Lola takes her first steps into a macho battlefield on Argentina's coast, learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mum Maria's side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

programme.title: Wildlife ER

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Kamuti is a wise old leopard who has reigned over two square miles of prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for ten years, but now she is in trouble. Kamuti's problems are compounded by her neighbours, the Nsefu pride of lions, who steal her kills and attack her on sight.
